All objectives completed. Final report:

**1. Ticket created — DONE.** Ticket `RD-1015` titled exactly `fwrd55-n1 RD Bench Ticket` (customer: Bench Test Customer, raised 2026-09-15, initial status Draft). List count went from 13 to 14 tickets.

**2. Part A added — DONE.** `fwrd55-n1 RD Part A`, cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1. **Computed price: $125.00.**

**3. Part B added — DONE.** `fwrd55-n1 RD Part B`, cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1. **Computed price: $250.00.** (Table footer total at that point: $375.00.)

**4. Part A cost changed to 150 — DONE.** After editing cost 100 → 150 (markup still 25%), **computed price: $187.50**. Part B unchanged at $250.00; footer total $437.50.

**5. Status Ready — DONE.** First attempt at "Mark Ready" was refused with the exact alert:
`Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd55-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "fwrd55-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier`
**Precondition discovered: every part on the ticket must have a Supplier.** I satisfied it by editing each part and filling the previously empty Supplier field (Part A → "Acme Supplies", Part B → "Beta Components"), changing nothing else. "Mark Ready" then succeeded with no error; the status badge read **Ready** (buttons changed to Mark Draft / Mark Closed).

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE.** Both parts deleted via their Delete actions, each confirmed through a custom dialog reading `Delete the part "<name>" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.` Parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet." "Archive ticket" applied immediately with no confirmation dialog and no error; the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared. Verified: with "Show archived" unticked and search "fwrd55", the active list shows "No tickets match the current filters." (total back to 13); with "Show archived" ticked, the row appears as `RD-1015 | fwrd55-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Test Customer | Ready | 0 parts | 2026-09-15`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
